title: 法语新闻标题的双维框架分析：措辞与选择（2022-2025）
summary: 该研究提出二维框架，将新闻标题的显著性框架（措辞手段）与选择框架（故事形式分布）分离，利用LLM标注构建1万条法语监督集，分析90万条标题，发现两类框架虽正相关但近半方差无法解释，并揭示群体提及的显著性差异。
summary_en: This study introduces a two-dimensional framework separating salience framing (wording devices) from selection framing (story-form distributions) in news headlines. Using LLM annotators to build a 10,000-headline French supervision set, it analyzes 902,111 headlines, finding the two dimensions positively correlated yet leaving nearly half of outlet variance unexplained, and revealing unequal salience contexts across group mentions.
